newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Pasminco shares soar on zinc rise.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Pasminco shares soar on zinc rise.

text.p: Shares of base metals miner Pasminco Ltd rose over five percent in early trade after the price of zinc hit a 10-month high on the London Metal Exchange.
At 10.45 a.m. (2045 GMT), Pasminco shares were 11 cents or 5.37 percent higher at A$2.16, just off the 26-month high of A$2.23 hit earlier.
"The zinc price is up and people are warming to the Century deal, so I would say that is the reason for the rise," one base metals analyst said.
Last week, Pasminco agreed to buy the Century zinc deposit in northern Queensland for A$345 million from global mining giant RTZ-CRA.
The zinc price rose in LME trade due to lower stock levels. It ended US$39 stronger at $1,109 per tonne.
